statement: Build DevRelay's WorkBreakdown module through the released RequirementsGathering and ArchitectureDesign workflow so approved scope becomes a complete set of bounded, traceable, independently executable and verifiable work-item drafts without executing or building code.
objectives: Expose one WorkBreakdown module with establish-breakdown and decompose-change operations.
Route from the presence of an approved WorkBreakdownBaseline rather than model or adapter discretion.
Use configured, replaceable WorkBreakdown adapters with Spec Kit and OpenSpec as defaults rather than operation-specific Core branches.
Emit one canonical WorkBreakdownDraft or WorkBreakdownChangeSetDraft containing discrete WorkItemDrafts and complete coverage dispositions.
Detect baseline or repository drift before adapter invocation.
Project validated planning relationships into TraceabilityGraph through a trusted contributor.
constraints: WorkBreakdown consumes approved requirements, project-overview, architecture, contract, repository, and traceability context through immutable references.
Adapters may propose domain references but cannot access or mutate TraceabilityGraph.
WorkBreakdown proposes dependency hints; WorkDependencyAnalysis alone owns the authoritative dependency DAG.
Assignment, ownership, estimates, schedules, execution status, produced changes, and completion evidence remain downstream.
WorkBreakdown never executes work, writes implementation code, or claims planned work has been completed.
The first implementation remains a small deterministic module slice, not a general workflow platform.
acceptanceCriteria: No WorkBreakdownBaseline selects establish-breakdown for either greenfield or existing projects; an approved baseline plus ApprovedChangePackage selects decompose-change.
Every baseline, disposition, repository snapshot, capability catalog, and approved change input is exact and content-bound.
Baseline or repository drift returns baseline_drift with diagnostics before adapter execution and no candidate output.

A successful operation emits exactly one WorkBreakdownDraft or WorkBreakdownChangeSetDraft with bounded WorkItemDrafts, mandatory coverage dispositions, dependency hints, and subordinate native artifacts.
Every work item carries typed approved-scope references, a verification plan, required evidence, and capabilities selected from the pinned provider-neutral catalog.
The WorkBreakdown Gate rejects unscoped work, uncovered authorized scope, and invalid source or traceability references.
A trusted contributor derives only approved planning-edge types and Core validates and atomically merges the update with a complete merge proof.
No WorkBreakdown output contains an authoritative dependency DAG, assignment, schedule, execution, code change, completion claim, or inverse traceability edge.
assumptions: WorkBreakdown 0.1.0 has not been published and can be introduced as a new exact module contract.
The configured OpenSpec chat bridge records this requirements run but does not claim OpenSpec CLI execution.
A stable WorkItemDraft ID is required for source references, coverage, and later dependency analysis.
